Chief_Complaint.content: Lip swelling after eating prawn soup
Chief_Complaint.source_text: CC: Lip swelling after eating prawn soup

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Lip swelling began approximately 30 minutes after ingestion of prawn soup
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Lip swelling began ~30 min post-ingestion of prawn soup

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Swelling is increasing and involves the upper lip
Patient reports difficulty breathing with possible throat swelling
Previous similar reaction occurred after eating curry
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Previous similar reaction after eating curry

Social_and_Family_History.content: Patient does not use antihistamines consistently

Assessment.content: Anaphylaxis suspected based on lip swelling, difficulty breathing, and dizziness after ingestion of prawn soup
Assessment.source_text: Lip swelling, difficulty breathing, dizziness post-ingestion of prawn soup

Plan_of_Care.content: Advise follow-up post-hospital discharge for potential prescription of emergency injection such as epinephrine
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Advise follow-up post-hospital discharge for potential prescription of emergency injection (e.g., epinephrine)

Follow_up_Information.content: Patient advised to follow up after hospital discharge
